name: Flat sandwich
summary: Flat sandwich: two triangle halves stacked with bread, cheese, ham, lettuce and tomato. Use for lunch or snack scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the sandwich rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~350 px wide); use about 0.2 to 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = rock on its base, pop = scale in
